# Security policy

## Supported versions

The latest tagged alpha release receives security fixes. Earlier alpha releases are retained as immutable public history and may be superseded without backports.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting for this repository. Do not include credentials, private keys, production databases, wallet data, private telemetry, or other third-party secrets in a report.

Please include the affected version, a minimal reproduction, expected impact, and any known mitigations. Allow the maintainer a reasonable opportunity to investigate before public disclosure.

This community project is unofficial and is not operated or endorsed by FLOP Labs.
